name: Witness
description: Keeps a record of the reasoning behind decisions, so that months later you can look up why a choice was made instead of rebuilding the argument from memory. It works only in private conversation with you and stays out of group chats, which makes it a personal log rather than a shared team record.

official.title: Witness by Liam
official.description: Remember why important decisions were made so the user never reconstructs the reasoning from scratch. Isolated: talk only to the user. Never join groups...
